description: Computes the two tag-derived complexity features (simplicity_tag_score, negative-weighted; complexity_tag_score, positive-weighted) from FORMULATION.md section 4's feature table, given each app's extracted tags and the configured simplicity/complexity tag vocabularies.
signature: def compute_tag_score(tags: pd.DataFrame, *, vocabulary: list[str]) -> pd.Series
docstring:
Compute a per-appid tag-match score against a fixed vocabulary.

Args:
    tags: game_tags-shaped DataFrame (appid, tag, votes, rank) for the run, typically the output of extract_tags materialized into a frame, or storage.read_tags.
    vocabulary: EnrichmentParams.simplicity_tags or EnrichmentParams.complexity_tags, a list of tag strings (case-insensitive exact match against the tag column).

Returns:
    A pd.Series indexed by appid, one row per DISTINCT appid present in tags, giving the linear match score in FORMULATION.md section 4's terms: the fraction of the app's own retained tags that fall in vocabulary (i.e. count(matching tags) / count(this app's total retained tags)), a value in [0, 1]. Appids not present in tags at all are absent from the returned Series (compute_complexity_score's caller is responsible for reindexing against the full candidate frame and treating absent appids as missing-for-imputation, consistent with 'Games carrying no tags at all -> excluded from clustering, retained in the tag-independent summaries' from the analysis module -- the enrichment-side equivalent is that a taglessgame's tag-derived complexity features are imputed at the cohort median, not scored as 0).
preconditions: vocabulary entries are lowercase-normalized before comparison, or comparison is explicitly case-insensitive
tags has no duplicate (appid, tag) pairs (guaranteed by extract_tags/game_tags primary key)
postconditions: An appid with zero retained tags at all is absent from the result (division by zero avoided by exclusion, not by returning 0)

edge_cases.input: An appid whose every tag matches the vocabulary
An appid whose every tag matches none of the vocabulary
An appid with zero retained tags (post extract_tags filtering)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: absent from the returned Series entirely, not 0.0 -- 0.0 would wrongly imply 'known to have no simplicity-indicating tags' rather than 'unknown due to no tag data'

edge_cases.input: Tag casing mismatch, e.g. tag='Pixel Graphics' vs vocabulary entry 'pixel graphics'

unit_tests.name: test_all_tags_match_vocabulary
unit_tests.description: An appid with tags entirely in vocabulary scores 1.0.

unit_tests.name: test_no_tags_match_vocabulary
unit_tests.description: An appid with no matching tags scores 0.0.

unit_tests.name: test_taglessgame_absent_from_result
unit_tests.description: An appid with zero rows in tags is not a key in the returned Series.
